title: The Landstar Link, Summer 2020
summary: In this issue of The Landstar Link newsletter, you'll read about the winner of the Landstar All-Star Truck Giveaway, the LandstarOne® mobile app, Landstar's new freight management system and more.
body_markdown:
The Landstar Link Summer 2020 newsletter is now available! In this issue, you'll read about:


- Bobby Jordan, winner of the Landstar All-Star Truck Giveaway
- The newest Landstar Roadstar® Honorees and Million Milers
- Updates to the LandstarOne® mobile app
- Clarity, Landstar's new freight management system
